name: claude
description: Use Claude Code from Codex for code reviews and to delegate tasks to Claude.

interface.shortDescription: Review and delegate with Claude Code
interface.longDescription: Runs your local Claude Code CLI from Codex: read-only and adversarial code reviews, delegated tasks with per-turn read, edit or shell access, and background jobs you can check, fetch and cancel. Uses your existing Claude Code login.
defaultPrompt: Use claude-setup to check that Claude Code is ready.
Use claude-review to review my uncommitted changes.
Use claude-rescue to investigate why the tests are failing.
